comment: The text says the Benefits Package Registry depends on the Client Registry to confirm scheme enrolment. The Client Registry should identify persons, while enrolment or beneficiary status is normally managed elsewhere.

anchor.note: p.117 l.Lines 158-164 read as the printed page; section 4 agrees

public.text: The text says the Benefits Package Registry depends on the Client Registry to confirm scheme enrolment. The Client Registry should identify persons, while enrolment or beneficiary status is normally managed elsewhere.
public.suggestedRevision: Revise to state that financing systems use the Client Registry to resolve person identity, while enrolment and eligibility are managed by the relevant beneficiary, scheme, or operational financing system.
